title: Heidi Bach
description: Prior to being elected, she told media she found the districts sex-ed program that taught kindergartners that gender is fluid to be “extremely appropriate.”
body:
# Heidi Bach

# Board Clerk

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/bach-profile.png)

- This was her FB banner photo:

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/WI-Wauwatosa-Bach-LOVE-photo.png)

- Prior to being elected, she **[told media](https://www.wpr.org/education/wisconsin-districts-face-backlash-over-plans-teach-gender-identity-elementary-students)** she found the districts sex-ed program to be “extremely appropriate.”

Was a part of the **[task force](https://go.boarddocs.com/wi/wauw/Board.nsf/files/D5ZPUD664BC5/$file/FINAL_Tosa%202075%20Task%20Force_Final%20Report_UPDATED.pdf)** that proposed closing the STEM program. The district is being sued because documents indicated it would be closed because there were too many white students.
